LESSON: RELATIONSHIP

Grade: Grade 2
Subject: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: Strand 6
Topic 6.2: Relationship

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! Today we learn about Relationship. Read the explanation, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

Big question: How do you help your b) Identify ways through which obligations towards their neighbour?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. Demonstrate love and care for crutches people with special needs.  Learners dramatise how to take care of people with special needs

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. Demonstrate love and care for crutches people with special needs.  Learners dramatise how to take care of people with special needs
   In simple words: practise until you can demonstrate love and care for crutches people with special needs.  Learners dramatise how to take care of people with special needs. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: Talk about Relationship using something you see at school in Kenya.

Example 2: Give a home example from your county, estate, or village.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Underline two new ideas about Relationship in the examples.
2. Explain Relationship to a parent using one local example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Relationship.
4. Show that you can: Demonstrate love and care for crutches people with special needs.  Learners dramatise how to take care of people with special needs

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Relationship using examples from school or home.
2. Answer: Why is Relationship important for a Grade 2 learner?
3. Make a one-minute oral presentation to a parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION 7: CLASS ACTIVITY IDEAS

1. Learners act short skits neighbours as an act of ibadah. demonstrating good relations with neighbours.
2. Learners are guided on how to help a blind 2. What assistance (3lessons) needs according to Islamic person to cross the road. can you offer to teachings.
3. Learners draw and colour wheel chair, c) Demonstrate love and care for crutches people with special needs.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. How do you help your b) Identify ways through which obligations towards their neighbour?
2. which people with special needs to avoid special needs?

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. Demonstrate love and care for crutches people with special needs.  Learners dramatise how to take care of people with special needs

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open the Answers tab only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original learner lesson from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
